definition: See the plan on the bench as a model, in the Drawing Set: the house built from its record and turned in the hand, with the flat drawings laid over it at their named views.
basis: Our wording of the way to the model. docs/scene.md: a continuous camera, "an orbit, a section plane moved by hand — needs a scene resident in the browser", and it needs no modelling kernel "because everything a camera can show is already in the record".
